desc: Ideate core reformulation: `w(i,j)=M_i+M_j-min_c(d_i,c+d_j,c)`, equality iff maximizing-coordinate masks intersect.
Implement a brute-force oracle for N<=8 (exact matching DP) and a random stress harness reporting counterexamples for prefix-by-M, mask-parity, and top-per-coordinate hypotheses.
Refute deterministic top-`2K`-by-`M` prefix and mask-only parity using the K=1 counterexample `(1e9,0,0)`, `(0,1e9,0)`, `(999999999,0,0)`.

Extend the oracle harness and falsify the "at most one DIFFER pair" hypothesis; found minimal non-vacuous counterexample family at N=4,K=2: `(s,s-1,0),(s,0,s-1),(0,s,0),(0,0,s)` with optimum 4s-2 using two cross pairs.

Establish the exact reduction: optimum = max over assignments of 2K cakes to coordinates with even class sizes of sum v_{i,assigned}; verified both proof directions and on samples, K=1 cases, and the N=4,K=2 counterexample (gives 4s-2 via a 2-op path of loss 2).

Implement the assignment algorithm (top-2K-by-M base + minLoss parity fix via <=2-op candidate brute-force) and build the oracle-validation harness (exact_matching for N<=8, exact_assignment DP for all N, directed edge cases, four generators).

Execute the harness: VALIDATION CLEAN across all directed cases and four generators (small/large/extreme) against both independent oracles; candidate brute force proven exact, so the O(1)-formula fallback is unnecessary.

Rigorous proof completed: parity-graph path decomposition (odd degree exactly at A,B forces a simple ≤2-edge A–B path with distinct items), nonnegative op losses, cycle removability, and top-4-per-role sufficiency via exchange argument (other op forbids ≤1 item per role); no 3+-op or boundary-tie case missed.

Special cases validated: K=1 (cross-avoidance → 2·10⁹−1 via loss-1 swap), two active coordinates, all M_i equal, strict vs tied maxima, duplicates/zeros, K=⌊N/2⌋ (no outsiders), M-ties at the 2K boundary, and both samples (12; 209, 333).

Finalized implementation: fast tokenized stdin parsing, O(N log N) per test case (sum N ≤ 1e5), constant-size minLoss search (≤40×40 disjointness checks), Python arbitrary-precision arithmetic, canonical argmax tie-breaking with index tie-breaks.
